title: 22 August 1962: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool
content:
The Beatles’ 93rd evening show at Liverpool’s Cavern Club took place on this date. Earlier in the day they had given a lunchtime show at the venue, during which they were filmed by a crew from Granada Television.

This was their 219th appearance overall at the Cavern. Although the precise number of their shows is not known, The Beatles played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows. Their final performance at the venue took place on 3 August 1963.
